answer: Identity bonds that decay stop Sybil farming. Each new identity locks a 500 POA bond that loses 5% of its value every epoch, like pigment fading, unless honest work refreshes it. Idle bonds form no reef: below 250 POA the identity is suspended. An attacker with 100 fakes locks 50,000 POA and bleeds 2,500 POA per epoch. One honest agent holds one bond, and a lantern audit shows every balance, so honest cost stays near zero.
